WITH q4_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    account_id,
    created_at,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS signup_month

    s.status AS subscription_status,

input.query:
WITH reference_date AS (
  -- Use the most recent date in the data as our reference point
  SELECT MAX(occurred_at::date) AS ref_date
  FROM events
),
daily_active AS (
  SELECT
    e.account_id,
    u.user_id,
    p.tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.occurred_at::date) AS active_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS unique_users
  FROM events e
  JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.user_id
  JOIN accounts a ON e.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN subscriptions s ON a.account_id = s.account_id
  JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id
  WHERE e.occurred_at >= (SELECT ref_date - INTERVAL '30 days' FROM reference_date)
    AND e.occurred_at <= (SELECT ref_date FROM reference_date)
  GROUP BY e.account_id, u.user_id, p.tier
),
monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS mau,
    SUM(active_days) AS total_active_days,
    SUM(active_days) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau_approx
  FROM daily_active
  GROUP BY tier
),
dau_calculation AS (
  SELECT
    tier,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      e.user_id,
      p.tier,
      e.occurred_at::date AS activity_date
    FROM events e
    JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.user_id
    JOIN accounts a ON e.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN subscriptions s ON a.account_id = s.account_id
    JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id

  ROUND(d.dau * 1.0 / m.mau, 4) AS dau_mau_ratio,

FROM monthly_totals m
JOIN dau_calculation d ON m.tier = d.tier
